description: This file defines an Exception class specific to handling calculation errors within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It extends a base exception class and includes an error handler callback method.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: Custom exception class for calculation-related errors within PhpSpreadsheet, extending the general PhpSpreadsheetException class.

methods.name: errorHandlerCallback
methods.description: A static method serving as an error handler callback that creates and throws an instance of this exception with relevant error details.
